description: `awk`'s own candidate list (`awk, gawk, mawk`) resolves through the case's own `fakes/` directory first on PATH (issue #450 item 4) -- named literally `awk` here, so no real `awk`/ImageMagick needs to be installed. `runtime.plugins.awk.env` reaches the child's own environment; the `--print-env` fake proves it.
